name: duopore-public-listing-revision-field-diff
description: See what changed between old and new versions of a property listing's details.

interface.longDescription: See what changed between old and new versions of a property listing's details. Share the same field names with before-and-after values. Get a clear list of edits so you can review the changes before using the new listing. It compares exact values only. It does not verify the facts or judge a change's legal effect.
defaultPrompt: Compare the old and new values in this property listing.
List the property fields that changed in this revision.

positive.prompt: Use Listing Revision Diff with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"propertyRef":"P1","fields":[{"field":"monthlyRent","before":"1200","after":"1250"},{"field":"bedrooms","before":"2","after":"2"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 of 2 listing fields changed.","rows":[{"field":"monthlyRent","before":"1200","after":"1250","propertyRef":"P1","changed":true,"status":"reviewChange"},{"field":"bedrooms","before":"2","after":"2","propertyRef":"P1","changed":false,"status":"unchanged"}],"warnings":["Supplied facts only; no address, tenant screening, legal assessment or verification.","Only supplied fields are compared, including exact spacing and case."]}
